name: Burpee
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Drop into a squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back into a plank position.
Perform a push-up.
Jump your feet forward to your hands.
Explode upward into a jump with arms overhead.
Land softly and repeat.

name: Mountain Climber
instructions: Start in a high plank position with hands under shoulders.
Drive your right knee toward your chest.
Quickly switch legs, driving your left knee forward while extending the right leg back.
Continue alternating at a rapid pace while keeping hips level.
Maintain a tight core throughout.

name: Jump Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat, pushing hips back and keeping chest up.
Explode upward, jumping as high as possible.
Swing your arms to generate momentum.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately descend into the next squat.

name: Tuck Jump
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, arms at your sides.
Bend your knees slightly and jump explosively upward.
At the peak, tuck both knees toward your chest.
Grab your shins briefly at the top if possible.
Extend your legs and land softly with knees slightly bent.
Reset and repeat.

name: Skater
instructions: Stand on your right foot with your left foot off the ground behind you.
Leap laterally to your left, landing on your left foot.
Swing your right leg behind your left ankle.
Immediately leap back to the right.
Continue alternating side to side in a skating motion.
Pump your arms across your body for balance.

name: Star Jump
instructions: Start in a quarter squat with arms close to your body.
Explode upward, spreading your arms and legs out wide to form an X or star shape.
Reach maximum extension at the peak of the jump.
Bring your limbs back in before landing.
Land softly in the starting quarter squat position.
Repeat immediately.

name: Squat Thrust
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back into a plank position.
Jump your feet back to your hands.
Stand up to the starting position.
Repeat at a fast pace.

name: Plyo Lunge
instructions: Start in a lunge position with your right foot forward and left knee near the ground.
Explode upward, jumping off both feet.
While airborne, switch your legs so the left foot lands forward.
Land softly in a lunge with the left leg forward.
Immediately jump and switch again.
Keep your torso upright throughout.

name: Speed Skater
instructions: Stand with feet together.
Leap as far as possible to the right, landing on your right foot.
Swing your left foot behind your right leg and reach your left hand toward the ground.
Pause briefly, then leap to the left.
Land on your left foot, swinging your right leg behind.
Continue bounding side to side with as much distance and speed as possible.

name: In-and-Out Squat
instructions: Stand with feet together.
Jump your feet out wide and lower into a sumo squat.
Touch the floor between your legs if possible.
Jump your feet back together and stand.
Repeat at a fast pace, keeping your chest up.
Engage your core throughout.

name: High Knees
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Drive your right knee up toward your chest as high as possible.
Quickly switch to drive your left knee up.
Pump your arms in opposition to your legs.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Maintain a fast pace as if sprinting in place.

name: Box Jump
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box or platform at arm's length.
Bend your knees and swing your arms back.
Explode upward, swinging your arms forward and jumping onto the box.
Land softly with both feet fully on the box, knees slightly bent.
Stand up fully on the box.
Step down carefully and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge at the hips, grip the kettlebell with both hands.
Hike the kettlebell between your legs.
Drive your hips forward explosively, swinging the kettlebell to chest or eye height.
Let the kettlebell fall back between your legs under control.
Maintain a flat back and engaged core throughout.
Repeat with a rhythmic hip-hinge pattern.

name: Kettlebell Clean
instructions: Stand over the kettlebell with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge at the hips and grip the kettlebell with one hand.
Hike the kettlebell back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and pull the kettlebell up close to your body.
Rotate your hand and catch the kettlebell in the rack position at your shoulder.
Keep your elbow tucked against your ribs.
Reverse the motion to swing back down and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Snatch
instructions: Stand over the kettlebell with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge and grip the kettlebell with one hand.
Hike it between your legs, then drive your hips forward explosively.
As the kettlebell rises, pull it close to your body.
Punch your hand through at the top so the kettlebell rolls gently over your wrist.
Lock out your arm overhead with the kettlebell resting on the back of your forearm.
Lower it back down in one fluid motion and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Turkish Get-Up
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell in your right hand with arm extended toward the ceiling.
Bend your right knee and place your right foot flat on the floor.
Roll onto your left elbow, then press up to your left hand.
Lift your hips off the ground into a bridge.
Sweep your left leg under your body and place your left knee on the ground.
Rise to a kneeling position, keeping the kettlebell overhead.
Stand up fully.
Reverse each step to return to the starting position.

name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold the kettlebell by the horns at chest height, close to your body.
Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, toes angled out.
Brace your core and descend into a deep squat.
Keep your chest up and elbows between your knees.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Repeat.

name: Kettlebell Windmill
instructions: Press a kettlebell overhead with your right arm, locking out your elbow.
Turn your feet about 45 degrees to the left.
Push your right hip out to the side.
Slowly hinge at the hip and lower your left hand toward your left foot.
Keep your eyes on the kettlebell overhead at all times.
Go as low as your flexibility allows while keeping the arm locked out.
Reverse the motion to stand back up.

name: Kettlebell Farmer's Walk
instructions: Pick up a heavy kettlebell in each hand.
Stand tall with shoulders pulled back and down.
Engage your core and look straight ahead.
Walk forward with steady, controlled steps.
Maintain an upright posture and avoid leaning.
Walk for the prescribed distance or time.
Set the kettlebells down carefully.

name: Kettlebell Halo
instructions: Hold the kettlebell upside down by the horns at chest level.
Circle the kettlebell around your head in a smooth arc.
Keep the kettlebell close to your head as it passes behind.
Engage your core and avoid moving your torso.
Complete the circle back to the starting position.
Reverse direction after the prescribed reps.

name: Battle Rope Alternating Waves
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding one end of the rope in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly and brace your core.
Raise your right arm up quickly while lowering your left.
Immediately reverse, raising the left and lowering the right.
Create alternating waves that travel down the rope.
Maintain a fast rhythm for the prescribed time.
Keep your core engaged and avoid excessive body movement.

name: Battle Rope Double Waves
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding one rope end in each hand.
Bend your knees and hinge slightly at the hips.
Raise both arms overhead simultaneously.
Slam both arms down forcefully to create a large wave.
Immediately raise them back up and repeat.
Use your legs and hips to generate additional power.
Maintain an aggressive pace for the prescribed duration.

name: Battle Rope Slams
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, holding one rope end in each hand.
Raise both arms overhead, extending onto your toes.
Slam the ropes down as hard as possible while dropping into a squat.
Let the ropes bounce off the floor.
Stand back up and immediately repeat.
Focus on maximum power with each slam.

name: Medicine Ball Slam
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a slam ball at chest height.
Raise the ball overhead, fully extending your body.
Slam the ball down to the ground as hard as possible.
Hinge at the hips and use your entire core to drive the ball down.
Pick the ball up and repeat immediately.
Maintain a fast tempo.

name: Wall Ball
instructions: Stand facing a wall about arm's length away, holding a medicine ball at chest height.
Descend into a full squat, keeping the ball at your chest.
Drive up explosively out of the squat.
At the top, throw the ball upward to hit a target on the wall (about 10 feet high).
Catch the ball on the rebound as you descend into the next squat.
Maintain a fluid rhythm.

name: Sled Push
instructions: Load the sled with the desired weight.
Grip the handles at chest or waist height.
Lean into the sled at a 45-degree angle.
Drive through your legs, pushing the sled forward with powerful steps.
Keep your core braced and back flat.
Continue pushing for the prescribed distance.
Maintain a low body angle for maximum force.

name: TRX Row
instructions: Hold TRX handles with arms extended, leaning back with body straight.
Keep feet flat on the ground, core engaged.
Pull your chest toward the handles by squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Keep elbows close to your body.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower yourself back to the start position under control.
Adjust difficulty by changing your body angle.

name: Barbell Thruster
instructions: Rack a barbell in the front rack position at your shoulders.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Descend into a full front squat.
Drive up explosively from the bottom of the squat.
Use the momentum to press the barbell overhead.
Lock out arms fully at the top.
Lower the bar back to the front rack position and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing in.
Descend into a full squat, keeping the dumbbells at your shoulders.
Drive up from the squat and press both dumbbells overhead in one fluid motion.
Lock your arms out at the top.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height as you descend into the next squat.
Maintain a brisk pace.

name: Man Maker
instructions: Start standing with a dumbbell in each hand.
Place the dumbbells on the ground and jump into a plank position.
Perform a push-up.
Do a renegade row on each side.
Jump your feet forward to the dumbbells.
Clean the dumbbells to your shoulders as you stand.
Press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower and repeat.

name: Devil Press
instructions: Start standing with a dumbbell in each hand.
Place the dumbbells on the ground and perform a burpee.
At the bottom, keep your hands on the dumbbells.
As you stand from the burpee, swing the dumbbells between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and snatch the dumbbells overhead in one powerful motion.
Lock out both arms overhead.
Lower the dumbbells and repeat.

name: Bear Complex
instructions: Start with the barbell on the floor.
Perform a power clean to bring the bar to your shoulders.
Perform a front squat.
Press the barbell overhead (push press or strict press).
Lower the bar behind your head to a back rack position.
Perform a back squat.
Press overhead again, then lower to the front rack.
That is one rep. Lower to the floor and repeat.

name: Clean and Press
instructions: Stand over the barbell with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips and grip the bar just outside your knees.
Pull the bar explosively from the floor, extending hips, knees, and ankles.
Catch the bar in the front rack position at your shoulders.
Dip slightly at the knees and press the bar overhead.
Lock out your arms fully.
Lower the bar back to the shoulders, then to the floor.

name: Sumo Deadlift High Pull
instructions: Stand with a wide sumo stance, toes pointed out, barbell between your feet.
Grip the barbell with a narrow grip.
Extend your hips and knees to lift the bar.
As the bar reaches hip height, shrug your shoulders and pull your elbows high.
Bring the bar up to chin height with elbows above the bar.
Lower the bar back to the floor under control.
Repeat.

name: Rowing Machine
instructions: Sit on the rower and strap your feet in.
Grab the handle with an overhand grip.
Push off with your legs first, extending your knees.
Once your legs are nearly straight, lean back slightly and pull the handle to your lower chest.
Reverse the motion: extend arms, lean forward, then bend knees to slide forward.
Maintain a smooth, rhythmic stroke.
Keep your core engaged throughout.

name: Assault Bike
instructions: Sit on the assault bike and grip the handles.
Start pedaling with your legs while pushing and pulling the handles.
Coordinate your upper and lower body for maximum output.
Maintain an upright torso.
Adjust intensity by increasing your speed or resistance.
Continue for the prescribed time or calories.

name: Pallof Press
instructions: Attach a resistance band at chest height to a sturdy anchor.
Stand sideways to the anchor, holding the band with both hands at your chest.
Step away to create tension on the band.
Press your hands straight out in front of your chest.
Hold for 2-3 seconds, resisting the band's pull to rotate you.
Bring your hands back to your chest.
Repeat for the prescribed reps, then switch sides.

name: Cable Woodchop
instructions: Attach a resistance band high on an anchor point.
Stand sideways to the anchor with feet shoulder-width apart.
Grip the band with both hands above your shoulder closest to the anchor.
Pull the band diagonally across your body toward your opposite hip.
Rotate your torso and pivot your feet as you chop down.
Return to the starting position under control.
Complete all reps on one side, then switch.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on your back with arms extended toward the ceiling and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Press your lower back firmly into the floor.
Slowly extend your right arm overhead and left leg out straight, lowering both toward the floor.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor throughout.
Return to the starting position.
Repeat on the opposite side.
Alternate sides for the prescribed reps.

name: Bird Dog
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Brace your core to stabilize your spine.
Simultaneously extend your right arm forward and left leg backward.
Hold the extended position for 2-3 seconds.
Return to the starting position.
Repeat with the left arm and right leg.
Keep your hips level and avoid rotating your torso.

name: Bear Crawl
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Lift your knees 1-2 inches off the ground.
Move your right hand and left foot forward simultaneously.
Then move your left hand and right foot forward.
Keep your hips low and back flat.
Continue crawling forward for the prescribed distance.
You can also crawl backward or laterally.

name: Inchworm
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Bend at the waist and place your hands on the floor (bend knees slightly if needed).
Walk your hands forward until you are in a plank position.
Optionally perform a push-up.
Walk your feet toward your hands in small steps, keeping legs as straight as possible.
Stand up and repeat.

name: Plank to Downward Dog
instructions: Start in a high plank position with hands under shoulders.
Push your hips up and back into a downward dog position.
Press your heels toward the floor and your chest toward your thighs.
Hold for a moment.
Shift forward, lowering your hips back to the plank position.
Repeat in a controlled rhythm.

name: Hollow Body Hold
instructions: Lie on your back with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your arms, head, shoulders, and legs a few inches off the ground.
Your body should form a shallow banana shape.
Keep your core tight and lower back glued to the floor.
Hold for the prescribed time.
If too difficult, bend your knees or bring your arms to your sides.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and feet slightly elevated.
Lean back to about a 45-degree angle, holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Rotate your torso to the right, bringing the ball beside your hip.
Rotate to the left, bringing the ball to the other side.
Keep your core engaged and move in a controlled manner.
Continue alternating for the prescribed reps.

name: Dumbbell Renegade Row
instructions: Get into a plank position with each hand gripping a dumbbell on the floor.
Keep your feet wider than hip-width for stability.
Row the right dumbbell up to your hip, squeezing your shoulder blade.
Lower the dumbbell back to the floor under control.
Row the left dumbbell up.
Continue alternating while keeping your hips square to the floor.
Avoid rocking side to side.

name: Resistance Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Hold a resistance band in front of you at shoulder height with both hands, arms extended.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull the band apart by squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Continue until the band touches your chest.
Slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the prescribed reps.
